newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 10.03 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 10.03 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold on Monday two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.70 percent and 17.58 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 10.033 billion levs ($4.3 million) of T-bills, and the ministry approved all of them.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance by the ministry.
Bids received 8,822.9 million levs 1,210 million levs
Avg price of bids 96.43 pct 85.05 pct
Bids approved 8,822.9 million levs 1,210 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.70 pct 17.58 pct
